title: PONO: Power Optimization with Near Optimal SMT-based Sub-circuit Generation
problem: Power-oriented sub-circuit generation for logic synthesis is rarely addressed in the literature. Generating high-quality sub-circuits that optimize power consumption while maintaining performance and area targets is a challenging problem.
motivation: Power consumption optimization in the sub-15nm technology era is critical for modern chip design.
method: PONO employs SMT (Satisfiability Modulo Theories)-based optimization to generate near-optimal power-efficient sub-circuits for local substitution in logic synthesis. The method enables construction of power-oriented circuit libraries and produces designs near the Pareto frontier of Power-Performance-Area tradeoffs, improving upon traditional rewrite-based logic optimization algorithms.
key_novelty: First SMT-based approach specifically targeting power-oriented sub-circuit generation to achieve near-optimal solutions on the PPA Pareto frontier.
contributions: SMT-based methodology for power-optimized sub-circuit generation
Near-optimal PPA Pareto frontier solutions for circuit design
8.7% power consumption reduction over traditional rewrite approaches without performance or area degradation
limitations: Limitations of the approach are not discussed in the abstract.
primary_theme: Power-optimized sub-circuit generation for logic synthesis
